title: Truth Seeker
style: Electronic punk with frantic half-time drums, distorted synth bass, and nervy guitar stabs; verse drives on clipped talk-singing and shouted doubles, pre-chorus tightens with rising filter sweeps, chorus punches open with gang vocals and a short chant hook. Bridge drops to a brittle drone and lone voice before the final lift. Glitch ticks, reversed zaps, and tape-stop turns between sections. Bright, aggressive, and claustrophobic mix., electronic, punk
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Truth seeker...
All these websites, no master plan
What are you doing, Corey?!
This is not for me?
It is.
Sweet.
Corey I got this.
The data, the data, the d-d-d-data!
I been up all night with a hungry screen
Prying through the noise for the in-between
Every tab says "trust me" with a crooked grin
But I can smell the lie when the line goes thin

[Pre-Chorus]
A B C D...
V VDS for me.
Can I get one?
For sure.
How much?
How much to bleed?
I don't want the pretty wrap
I want the thing behind the map

[Chorus]
Truth seeker, truth seeker
Say it loud, say it loud
Truth seeker, truth seeker
Pull it out, pull it out
Free as free can be
Free as free can be
Before you pay the stack
Give it back, give it back

[Verse 2]
No, I’m not buying the shine today
No polished lie in a checkout tray
If it costs my pulse, then it costs too much
If it hides the seam, then I don't trust the touch
Corey, look at me, I need the raw
Need the crack in the code and the edge of the law
Need the first clean cut through the smoke and glass
Need the part they bury when the questions pass

[Pre-Chorus]
A B C D...
V VDS for me.
Can I get one?
For sure.
How much?
How much to bleed?
I want the name, the chain, the proof
I want the one small crack in the roof

[Chorus]
Truth seeker, truth seeker
Say it loud, say it loud
Truth seeker, truth seeker
Pull it out, pull it out
Free as free can be
Free as free can be
Before you pay the stack
Give it back, give it back

[Bridge]
[Breakdown]
What are you doing, Corey?!
Not for me?
It is.
Then show me the seam
Show me the hand
Show me the place where the truth can't stand
The data, the data, the d-d-d-data!
Ain't a gold chain gonna save that

[Final Chorus]
Truth seeker, truth seeker
Say it loud, say it loud
Truth seeker, truth seeker
Pull it out, pull it out
Free as free can be
Free as free can be
Before you pay the stack
Give it back, give it back

[Outro]
Truth seeker...
All these websites, no master plan
Truth seeker...
I know exactly where I stand
